isFree.question: Do I have to pay?
isFree.answer: No. Common tools are free to use—no signup and no watermarks.

areFilesSecure.question: Do my files go to your servers?
areFilesSecure.answer: No. Processing happens in your browser. Files aren’t uploaded to us.

platforms.question: Does it work on computers and phones?
platforms.answer: Yes. Open the site in a modern browser on Windows, Mac, or mobile.

gdprCompliant.question: How do you handle privacy?
gdprCompliant.answer: Files aren’t uploaded or stored. We don’t get your document contents, so there’s nothing for us to collect.

dataStorage.question: Do you keep usage history?
dataStorage.answer: No. We don’t store your files or processing history. Close the page and that session ends.

different.question: How is this different from other online PDF sites?
different.answer: Many sites upload files to a server first. Here, processing runs in your browser instead.

browserBased.question: Why emphasize on-device processing?
browserBased.answer: Your files stay on your device and don’t travel through our servers, which means less exposure.

analytics.question: Do you track me with cookies?
analytics.answer: We don’t do behavioral tracking or analytics that identify who you are or which files you used.

merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.description: Combine whole files, or select specific pages to merge into a new document.
fileModeInstructions: Click and drag the icon to change the order of the files.
In the "Pages" box for each file, you can specify ranges (e.g., "1-3, 5") to merge only those pages.
Leave the "Pages" box blank to include all pages from that file.
pageModeInstructions: All pages from your uploaded PDFs are shown below.
Simply drag and drop the individual page thumbnails to create the exact order you want for your new file.
